entities.description: A young girl with long, wavy brown hair is looking down while writing in an open notebook with a black pen. She is wearing a light blue denim shirt over a white t-shirt and has a focused expression.

A young boy with short, dark, curly hair sits at a wooden desk, looking down with a focused expression while writing in an open notebook with a black pen.
